summary: Novità feature end-to-end (backend + UI). Backend: 17/17 pytest passed (preview check logging, simulate 3 drafts with correct audiences, re-simulate 409 + no duplicates, 404 unknown release, drafts hidden from org users / unread-count unaffected, admin endpoints forbidden for org, edit validation (plans empty / service empty / empty title -> 400), edit+publish, audience visibility (org sees 'all' and plan-matching, NOT superadmin/service), needs_completion publish -> 400, manual create (generator manual) + plans=[gold] visible to gold trial org, plans=[bronze,silver] NOT visible, mark-read/unread-count, dismiss-banner then newer news reappears, withdraw hides, simulate a different release creates its own 3 drafts). UI: checks panel 'Anteprima' + last check updates on 'Controlla ora'; simulate button -> 'Già simulato' disabled; edit dialog (title/area/audience plans gold) saves; publish; manual create via dialog + publish; org Dashboard banner with title/date + '2 novità da leggere' badge, header count 2; 'Scopri le novità' -> /novita with 'Nuova' badges; category filter and 'Solo non lette' work; count 0 and banner gone after reading; close banner hides it, reload keeps hidden, newer publish shows it again without logout; SA header icon on /piattaforma and after org switch, NewsBanner on /piattaforma, SA /novita sees superadmin+service news; mobile 390px header icon/banner/news page usable (no horizontal overflow). One flaky UI issue found on the News page (Nuova badges lost).

minor.issue: Pre-existing: deleting an org leaves its admin user orphaned (org_id=null, active=true); had to delete users separately via DELETE /api/platform/users/{id}.

ui_bugs.issue: Race: the effect does GET /news then POST /news/mark-read. Under React.StrictMode (index.js) the effect runs twice; the second GET /news can resolve after mark-read so items arrive with read=true and the 'Nuova' badges / teal borders disappear right after the page opens. Reproduced on the 390px run (backend log order: GET /api/news, POST /api/news/mark-read, GET /api/news). Desktop runs showed badges correctly, so it's intermittent. Fix: add a cancelled flag in the effect (let alive=true; ... if(!alive) return; return () => { alive=false }) or a ref guard so only one fetch+mark-read runs, and/or keep the first unread snapshot.

issues: Org users see the targeting chip 'Piani: GOLD' / 'Modulo: x' on cards. This exposes internal targeting and may confuse users. Consider showing it only to the Super Admin.
The 'Scopri CRMEvent con una demo gratuita' modal appears on top of the Novità banner on first login. This is expected behaviour, not a bug, but the banner can't be clicked until the modal is closed.

action_items: Fix News.jsx double fetch/mark-read race so 'Nuova' badges stay visible for the items that were unread when the page opened.
Optional: hide audience chips on /novita for non-superadmin users.
critical_code_review_comments: news.py _is_read checks rd.seen_at, but nothing ever writes seen_at. It is dead code: remove it or implement it.
news_reads.read_ids grows without limit ($addToSet) and keeps ids of deleted news. Consider pruning it, or use a seen_at watermark.

_visible loads up to 500 published items and filters them in Python for every unread-count call (this runs on every route change). Fine for now; consider a Mongo-side audience filter and an index on status+published_at.
NewsBanner keeps its 'hidden' state locally after close; it only resets on remount. This is OK because the server's dismissed_at is the source of truth.
The old tests/test_news.py has a hardcoded default BASE_URL (violates the env-only rule).
seed_data_creation: Created and then fully cleaned up: 2 TEST_NEWS orgs + their admin users (test_news_*@example.com) and their news_reads; news simulated from 2026-11-18-associazione-abbonamenti (twice: pytest + UI) and 2026-10-08-novita (pytest); manual TEST_NEWS items; 1 direct-DB needs_completion test draft. All withdrawn and deleted by id. The remaining news_items are the 2 pre-existing drafts from 2026-10-07-team-mobile, which were not mine and were left untouched. A few news_checks log entries and audit entries remain. No emails were sent by the test flows (registration may trigger registered-user sync).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_news_audience.py -n 0. It creates and cleans up its own data. New trial orgs get plan 'gold' from /api/saas/me. A new org's first login shows a demo modal ('Non ora' closes it) plus a cookie banner ('Accept all'). The SA org switcher state lives in localStorage and defaults to the newest org.
